title: 5b-1: basic component discovery — schema + Louvain + MCP
description:
## Parent

sutra/44 (5b PRD: component discovery + vocabulary)

## What to build

End-to-end component discovery on a fresh codebase. Schema migration for all 5 tables (components, component_membership, semantic_anchors, component_events, aliases — durable/ephemeral partitioned per 5a pattern). Louvain community detection on the file-level call graph from `build_file_adjacency`. First-run path: all clusters become new components, auto-named from longest common path prefix. `.sutra/components.toml` for resolution parameter override. MCP tool `sutra_components` to list discovered components with their member files.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Schema migration creates 5 tables with correct durable/ephemeral partition annotations in TABLE_REGISTRY
- [ ] Louvain clustering runs on file adjacency graph with 1/ambiguity weighting
- [ ] Resolution parameter auto-tunes by default, overridable via `.sutra/components.toml`
- [ ] First-run produces components with auto-generated names (common path prefix)
- [ ] Components get stable UUIDs stored in durable table
- [ ] `sutra_components` MCP tool returns components with member files
- [ ] Integration test: synthetic call graph → expected cluster count and composition

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.

messages.text:
Codex review (adversarial): needs-attention

Finding 1 [high] — Durable component sentinel blocks regeneration of ephemeral membership (src/components.rs:278-316)
discover_components returns as soon as any durable row exists in components, but component_membership is ephemeral and dropped during Db::reindex. After reindex, durable UUIDs survive but memberships are gone; next parse hits the gate and refuses to rederive. Also: component + membership inserts are not one transaction — partial failure poisons the same way.

Finding 2 [medium] — Auto-tune rejects balanced two-community results (src/components.rs:209-229)
Viability filter requires largest community < 50% of nodes (strict). Excludes every legitimate two-way balanced split. Auto-tune can discard the only valid candidate and fall back to gamma 1.0.

Recommended follow-ups:
- Reindex/regeneration test: create components → reindex → reparse → assert memberships restored
- Auto-tune regression test: balanced two-cluster graph where gamma 1.0 collapses but higher gamma splits correctly
